IGUI_ALifeUI_33d4c59b50ecb321.baglam: Industrial Salvagers · tutum: neutral · A large salvage gang out of the works yard. Numbers instead of discipline: they arrive together and they swarm.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7c9dbe3b28de3a3c.baglam: Military Holdouts · tutum: careful · What is left of a Kentucky Army National Guard detachment of the 149th Armored Brigade. They hold their range, work in lanes, and treat a firefight as a job rat

IGUI_ALifeUI_33296b8f4fe83d12.baglam: Military Quarantine Force · tutum: careful · The Army's line round the Exclusion Zone, drawn by the 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault) out of Fort Campbell, still standing where the order left it. Masks

IGUI_ALifeUI_70ae2d8168d8823e.baglam: Law Remnant · tutum: neutral · Deputies still running the county by their own reading of it. Shotguns at the door, sidearms behind, and an officer who calls the shots.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5d07593a248f3abb.baglam: Emergency Services · tutum: allied · A fire crew that never stood down. Axes and one shotgun between them, they move as one body and they carry their wounded out.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4986a0713112d5d3.not: Sadece kesme işareti: ’ (kıvrık) yerine ' (düz). Diğer bütün satırlarda düz olan kullanılıyor.
IGUI_ALifeUI_4986a0713112d5d3.baglam: Civilian Holdouts · tutum: careful · Neighbours who armed themselves. Not soldiers: they scavenge, they stay together, and they break when it turns bad.

IGUI_ALifeUI_23c4014e051998c5.not: Eski: "4 No.lu Karakolun Eyalet Polisleri". Sözlükte outpost = karakol oldu; bu ad oyuncuya A-Life karakolu gibi okunabilir. KSP'nin "Post 4"ü bir bölge karakolu, "4. Bölge" hem kısa hem çakışmasız.
IGUI_ALifeUI_23c4014e051998c5.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: neutral · Post 4 troopers still working US-31W in the first week: roadblocks, missing-person sweeps, a radio that still answers.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2653d224391266eb.not: Eski: "Şerif". Fraksiyon tek kişi değil, şerif ve yardımcılarından kalanlar (blurb: "the county sheriff and what is left of his deputies").
IGUI_ALifeUI_2653d224391266eb.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: friendly · The county sheriff and what is left of his deputies, holding the courthouse road and the town squares while the county still means something.

IGUI_ALifeUI_214357cf1e950acc.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: careful · Muldraugh's chief and his two cruisers. Small-town police: they know everybody, and they are not ready for this.

IGUI_ALifeUI_383353687bb40eb4.not: Eski: "Cezaevi Görev Ekibi". Bu adliye bodrumundaki ilçe tutukevi (jail); "cezaevi" Rosewood hapishanesi (prison) için kullanılıyor. Ayrım korunursa iki fraksiyon karışmaz.
IGUI_ALifeUI_383353687bb40eb4.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: careful · The jail detail from the courthouse basement, keeping the lockup and the block around it while the trusties still answer to them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_13321b770c09bf51.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: neutral · Fish and Wildlife officers on the rivers and in the knobs, the only law in the back country and used to being alone.

IGUI_ALifeUI_29b91803546ef549.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: careful · The clerks and one deputy who never left the courthouse. They keep records nobody will read and a door nobody gets through.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0b7d4b3c47002e95.baglam: 1993 / Law Enforcement · tutum: neutral · A roadside work crew that walked off when the officer stopped coming back. Boilersuits under stolen jackets, moving at night.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7203827e7fc942aa.tr: ABD Ordusu Zırhlı Okulu Kadrosu - Fort Knox
IGUI_ALifeUI_7203827e7fc942aa.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · US Army Armor Center cadre off Fort Knox, the Armor School instructors and crews, working the 31W corridor in the first week with a helicopter still on call.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5a0ab60f692a2ff5.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · Fort Knox military police on the roads into the installation: checkpoints, curfew, and a patience that is running out.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4559d63d1ea94b57.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · A Kentucky Guard engineer platoon of the 149th Armored Brigade, called up for the bridge works and the road blocks. Tools, trucks, and one rifle in three.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3c715a8518936452.not: G: "2. Tabur 123. Zırhlı - Tüfek Müfrezesi". Türkçede birlik büyükten küçüğe yazılır; "rifle detail" askerî Türkçede piyade.
IGUI_ALifeUI_3c715a8518936452.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · A Kentucky Army National Guard rifle detail of 2nd Battalion, 123rd Armor -- your neighbours with a drill weekend -- holding a cordon it was told to hold.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4ddbc17b734b43c6.tr: ABD Darphane Polisi - Kasa Görev Ekibi
IGUI_ALifeUI_4ddbc17b734b43c6.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · United States Mint Police from the depository. Another service, another uniform, a much smaller number; they answer to nobody here.

IGUI_ALifeUI_09baad1a3d97a5b9.baglam: 1993 / Military · tutum: careful · The Left-Behind: soldiers who stopped taking orders and kept the rifles. They are not looking for a fight, and they win the ones they get.

IGUI_ALifeUI_199c3da66369de64.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: careful · The volunteer fire department, pagers on every belt, still answering calls in the first days because nobody told them to stop.

IGUI_ALifeUI_501013037d2d3dd9.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: friendly · A county ambulance crew working the highway wrecks until the fuel and the will run out.

IGUI_ALifeUI_301a08fd26016f69.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: careful · Hospital staff holding a ward in Louisville: scrubs, tired eyes, and the only people who still know what to do with a wound.

IGUI_ALifeUI_10d2d844100f4791.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: careful · A relief column that made it into the county: cots, water and a coordinator with a clipboard, asking where the shelter is.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5a97f4ae2f5893eb.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: careful · The Station: three people, a transmitter and a generator, still on the air for whoever is listening.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7686973864d88d3a.baglam: 1993 / Relief and Utilities · tutum: careful · A utility line crew caught out on a service road with the bucket truck, trying to get home.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1e96f4377a4214d4.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Vittitoe Barns: six hundred acres of burley east of Muldraugh, four brothers, a granary and an armoury. They feed people who work.

IGUI_ALifeUI_38012b05586e9ad6.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: hostile · Renfro Road: thirty years of running liquor into a dry county. The road is theirs now, and they charge to use it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_70f25d21644d3acc.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Tackett Hollow: marijuana in the corn, one federal case, nobody talked. Same ground, same silence, more guns.

IGUI_ALifeUI_26d9b3a4313bb744.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Bledsoe Landing: barge deckhands and gravel dredgers at the West Point ramp. They move people and goods on the water, for a price.

IGUI_ALifeUI_701921802af4833b.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Prather Congregation: a West Point church that took people in and asks what you believe. They will feed you; they will not arm you.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3df5d5dc2234438a.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: hostile · Coyle Pawn: bought what soldiers sold. The county's fence and gun market; they sell to anyone with something to trade.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1ec1c07b49c4cc2b.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Ledford Camp: a deer camp and a cockfighting pit in the knobs. Hunters who moved to a new animal, and sporting about it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_59a11b2434faf87a.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Kessinger Dairy: a big family that walled the milking parlour and took in the cousins. Exhausted, careful, dangerous when pushed.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6542a74a2cdc8855.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Slaughter Fire Hall: the chief and two generations of volunteers. They kept the pumper running and put out fires for payment in fuel.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5c11748016498fb1.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Napier Row: laid off in the drawdown, took the trailer row and the ground it sits on. A chip on every shoulder.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3457b5d35a6a0c8d.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Whitaker Elevator: bought and dried the county's corn. They own the food and the scales, and they will starve you out.

IGUI_ALifeUI_465ee8fe1345588f.not: Eski: "Dabney Kliniği". Blurb: "a vet and a boarding barn"; ilçedeki tek doktor bir veteriner, esprisi de bu.
IGUI_ALifeUI_465ee8fe1345588f.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Dabney Practice: a vet and a boarding barn turned holdout. Medicine at a price nobody likes, from the only doctor left in the county.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2358948b449ed87a.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Crume Scrap: crushed cars on 31W, now cutting steel plate for anyone with fuel. They armour the trucks, and themselves.

IGUI_ALifeUI_687f582212c5fafb.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: hostile · The Hobbs brothers: small-time thieves with no home, following other people's fights and taking what is left.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0ece3aca2ab7751b.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · The Cornfield Men: growers who never had much use for the law and have less now. Patient, hidden, and armed for the harvest.

IGUI_ALifeUI_69e1766c7106d384.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · County Line Runners: bootleggers who know every back road between the wet county and the dry one, and who is on them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_08ac571f4e94456d.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · Dixie Road Crew: highway thieves who set the road and wait. When a car stops, they come out of both ditches.

IGUI_ALifeUI_467053ae1d2f679d.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · Iron Horse Club: the local motorcycle club, a garage on 31W and a grudge against the Louisville chapters.

IGUI_ALifeUI_15b05b6211c5f46b.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · Derby Street Set: a Louisville corner crew that kept its block when the police stopped coming.

IGUI_ALifeUI_11877ac75a225066.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: careful · Barn Cutters: a chop shop in a tobacco barn. Parts for anything, no questions, cash or fuel.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3fac48cd051d2338.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · The Pit: a fighting ring that outgrew its warehouse. Padded, helmeted, and hungry for a crowd.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3537aceb1e73cafd.baglam: 1993 / Local Crews · tutum: hostile · The Toll: a protection racket dressed up as a militia. One stretch of road, a gate, and a price that goes up.

IGUI_ALifeUI_41006a363f6cf6b5.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · Truck Stop Commune: drivers who were passing through and stayed. Diesel, CB radio, and a lot of guns behind the counter.

IGUI_ALifeUI_558b0ad077bc4743.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · County Gun Club: people who owned rifles before it was necessary, and know how to use them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_57e47b9910786d50.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · The Prepared: a family that built the cellar for exactly this, and does not want company.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5ff1754b40c336f7.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · Schoolhouse: teachers who kept the building and whoever came to it. Friendly, organised, and out of food.

IGUI_ALifeUI_041647646d3481c6.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · Stockyard Co-op: cattlemen who pooled the herds and the feed. Nobody eats for free.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5646f73056a89eeb.baglam: 1993 / Survivors · tutum: careful · Rivermen: towboat and barge crews off the Ohio, working the wharfs for whatever floats.

IGUI_ALifeUI_08fded904bb97593.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Outlaws MC: the Louisville chapter, a clubhouse, and a road they mean to own. Patrols, tolls and fuel runs -- the club has influence, and it wants more.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0b082e5206f0d17a.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Grim Reapers MC: the other Louisville club, a separate clubhouse and an old war with the Outlaws that did not end with the world.

IGUI_ALifeUI_14493bbf62e3b054.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Undertakers MC: riders from out of the region, come to see what the Outlaws are holding, and friendly to them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2e5c24ee2ee75b52.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: careful · Dixie Mafia contacts: the highway network of thieves and fences from prison days, working the motels on 31W.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6101189d4e3a2980.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Cornbread Mafia remnants: growers from the syndicate years who still know where the patches are and still do not talk.

IGUI_ALifeUI_589eb14c54aae1c6.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Chicago Outfit contacts stranded in a Louisville motel, with a car, a briefcase and a phone that does not ring.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3411b1fa53e2da9b.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Vice Lords crew stranded in Louisville: one block, held hard, with I-65 closed behind them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_34b073c3294dcee1.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: careful · Gangster Disciples crew stranded in Louisville, holding a block of their own and watching the Vice Lords' block.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5079af283fd67c78.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: careful · Bloods -- the Victory Park crew. Red on every cap, a set of streets, and a war across the park that outlasted the city.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6bd54e7361ad2db9.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: hostile · Crips -- the Victory Park crew. Blue on every cap, the other half of the park, the other half of the war.

IGUI_ALifeUI_71f090b2330b163f.baglam: 1993 / Clubs and Networks · tutum: careful · First Family contacts: made men who drove down from the north and cannot drive back. Suits, sidearms, and a plan.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5c71efb424544d96.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: neutral · Rosewood Police: the station by the prison road, three officers and the town.

IGUI_ALifeUI_182267eb45debaea.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · Riverside Police: a chief and two officers on the river road.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1a34ca5a7ca69b7f.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · West Point Police: the station on the Dixie Highway, holding the town and the river bank.

IGUI_ALifeUI_44fdfae81283ad2c.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: neutral · Louisville Division of Police: city police inside the city line, and not on speaking terms with the county force.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0b131c8924604fe8.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: neutral · Jefferson County Police: the county force outside the city line, and not on speaking terms with the city one.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1932515f7354c28c.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · KSP Special Response Team: the state police tactical unit, sent in once and never called back.

IGUI_ALifeUI_52406ae634dc7e79.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · Rosewood Corrections: the prison staff who kept the gate, the walls and whoever was inside them.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2b28217816d51833.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · Prison infirmary staff: two nurses and a doctor behind a locked wing, still treating whoever comes to the door.

IGUI_ALifeUI_41552084465f861c.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: hostile · Prison shelter group: inmates who barred a cell block and want nothing but to be left alone in it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_315d0bc72ecb4d71.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: hostile · Prison yard predators: the men the walls were for. Magazines taped over the chest, shivs, and the guards' shotgun.

IGUI_ALifeUI_398bf2ce149be8de.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: neutral · A prison escape pair on the road to the woods, in stolen jackets over prison khaki.

IGUI_ALifeUI_06afc4c02dbbffe9.baglam: 1993 / Police and Corrections · tutum: careful · Corrections remnants: guards who held a wing after the state stopped paying, then a house after the wing fell.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7721c2147a73e6e0.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Trooper remnants: a post that never got relieved. Grey shirts under civilian coats, still stopping cars on 31W.

IGUI_ALifeUI_463983ee67277482.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · County law remnants: deputies running their own county out of a house, the badge still on the belt.

IGUI_ALifeUI_321add226cd7135f.not: G: "Kentucky Muhafızları Kalıntıları". "Kalıntı" harabe çağrışımı yapıyor; senin "Gardiyanlardan Kalanlar", "Şeriflikten Kalanlar" kalıbına uyduruldu.
IGUI_ALifeUI_321add226cd7135f.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Kentucky Guard remnants: a 149th Armored Brigade platoon that stopped taking orders and kept the field depot.

IGUI_ALifeUI_45c3881c52f87146.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Engineer holdouts: 149th Armored Brigade Guard engineers who kept the workshop and the generator, and trade repairs for food.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3f1b53ef1593ec36.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Training remnants: a 1st Armor Training Brigade platoon cut off on the range roads, half-trained and led by one sergeant.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1bab024976b44359.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Conservation remnants: two officers living out of a forest camp, keeping the woods the way they always did.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1af3874621b01451.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Guard transport detail of the 149th Armored Brigade: truck drivers with a convoy that went nowhere, guarding what is on the trucks.

IGUI_ALifeUI_107b6ad2302c9bd9.baglam: 1993 / Uniformed Remnants · tutum: careful · Army medical detail: a field aid station out of Ireland Army Community Hospital at Fort Knox, treating soldiers first and everybody eventually.

IGUI_ALifeUI_509071b12a05febc.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Off-duty paramedics holding a house and a kit bag, still going out when they hear a crash.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3b87b93533aa0116.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Ward survivors: the patients and one nurse who were on the floor the hospital lost, and kept the ward.

IGUI_ALifeUI_461be2ed78164d01.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Utility survivors: a co-op crew holding a workshop, trading generator work for anything that burns.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4bac281803580821.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · The state highway crew, dump trucks and salt shed, still clearing wrecks in the first days.

IGUI_ALifeUI_57ed158e49dd285e.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: neutral · A two-man telephone crew at a switching point, waiting for a dial tone that is not coming.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7b88886e1a71a3c7.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Waterworks staff keeping the pumps going as long as the diesel lasts.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1598db28594e5175.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · A sanitation crew that kept the truck and the yard. They know every back alley in town.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1a1a78b623c7f8b1.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Rail maintenance survivors along the CSX line: a siding, a hi-rail truck, and miles of track nobody else walks.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0cc5d1127b516908.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Rickhouse hands: distillery workers holding a warehouse worth a fortune in barrels, and they know it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_75a162b55e3d4899.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Warehouse night shift: the crew that was on the floor when it happened and never went home. Awake all night.

IGUI_ALifeUI_14afe6f2386e5bf1.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Pharmacy survivors: the pharmacist, a technician and the stock room, which everyone in the county wants.

IGUI_ALifeUI_63a8199c5b23e1e1.baglam: 1993 / Workers · tutum: careful · Postal holdouts: carriers who know every house on the route and which ones are still answering.

IGUI_ALifeUI_568e724849e6f54e.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · The Bell household, Riverside: a family in its own house with the doors barred and the shotgun by the stairs.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7e538c8c6409bef6.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Freeman Porch: a Louisville row house, three generations, and a porch nobody steps onto uninvited.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5d959e796224ea3c.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Hensley Orchard on the Fallas Lake edge: apples, a cider press, and a family that will trade fruit for ammunition.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4868b421231ba1f2.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Mercer Auto: a Muldraugh garage family that keeps the shop, fixes what rolls in, and sleeps upstairs.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5ebdb71b18e00dba.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Ortiz Kitchen: a Louisville restaurant family living over the shop, feeding the block from what is left in the walk-in.

IGUI_ALifeUI_239978f13a48647a.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Nguyen Tailors: a small Louisville shop, a family behind the shutters, and a very good eye for who is at the door.

IGUI_ALifeUI_5ecd80cd49cab175.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Bauer Dairy near Ekron: German farm stock, a herd to keep alive and a fence line they walk twice a day.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2b8846102bc60665.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · The Walker duplex, West Point: two families who knocked the wall through and share one door.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6c5cf0845ec64d6d.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Price Motor Court: the family that ran the roadside motel and still rents rooms, for the right trade.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4aeb2ccf7db8a422.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Sutter Hardware, Rosewood: nails, chain, tools and a family that sleeps in the stock room with a shotgun.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3d5d63fb4f40fdf0.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · The Lawson cousins in a March Ridge house: four of them, related by marriage and by what they did to keep it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_616b23ae4d9d49fa.baglam: 1993 / Families · tutum: careful · Turner Homestead outside Brandenburg: a smallholding, a well, and a family that has never needed the town.

IGUI_ALifeUI_7a2a7d5f284c7a83.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · A stranded commuter in a suit, still carrying the briefcase, walking home from a car that will not start.

IGUI_ALifeUI_228c8e9807736881.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: neutral · A lost hiker on the trails who has not seen a road in days and does not know what happened to the towns.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6dde43010c07f80a.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: friendly · A night-shift nurse who walked off the ward with her kit and has been walking since.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6f87b85c0c8089e0.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · A retired neighbour who is not leaving the house, thank you, and has the revolver from the bedside drawer.

IGUI_ALifeUI_272fbd635e7e328e.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · A stranded courier with a satchel of somebody else's mail and a bicycle helmet, working the roads.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2af55db97f9b7299.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: neutral · A roadside mechanic under somebody's bonnet, with a toolbox and no intention of leaving the car.

IGUI_ALifeUI_340a80795675059d.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · A married couple who left the house together and have not been apart since.

IGUI_ALifeUI_712fe5ca6cc7282c.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: neutral · Adult siblings working the neighbourhood house by house, arguing the whole way.

IGUI_ALifeUI_6711ef8538efd79a.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · Two co-workers who were on shift together and are still on shift, in a way.

IGUI_ALifeUI_67179ce975b45658.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · Fishing partners at a cabin on the bank, living off the river and a deer rifle.

IGUI_ALifeUI_583e3d8c62ba3019.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: neutral · Two travellers from a motel room on 31W, out of state, out of gas and out of ideas.

IGUI_ALifeUI_1376e5a41c7d7ba4.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · Apartment watch: one Louisville block that organised, floor by floor, with a rota on the stairwell door.

IGUI_ALifeUI_50aa3c89724166d6.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · Trailer neighbours at the other end of the Muldraugh park: not Napiers, and they want that understood.

IGUI_ALifeUI_66c7429c21c850d7.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: careful · Diner survivors: the cook, the waitress and the regulars who were there when it started, still there.

IGUI_ALifeUI_2002982c091c9f87.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: friendly · Church volunteers running a shelter in a church that is not Prather's, and glad of the difference.

IGUI_ALifeUI_07241e4030334743.baglam: 1993 / Lone Survivors and Households · tutum: neutral · Refugee walkers: a column out of Louisville coming down 31W on foot, carrying everything, going anywhere.

IGUI_ALifeUI_206f2aec51224664.baglam: 1993 / Late Factions · tutum: hostile · Napier Collectors: the Napier cousins who went from taking the trailer row to taking everything on the roads around it.

IGUI_ALifeUI_4593f3440f8c75db.baglam: 1993 / Late Factions · tutum: hostile · Knob Stalkers: hunters who work the farm edges at night with scoped rifles and never show themselves twice.

IGUI_ALifeUI_07d8a83132102213.baglam: 1993 / Late Factions · tutum: hostile · Bone Raiders: the far camp, armoured in bone and hide, come down from the knobs when the food runs out.

IGUI_ALifeUI_3cd9735614d7c31d.baglam: 1993 / Late Factions · tutum: hostile · Cinder Crew: burned out of the industrial yards and black with it. Masks, aprons, leather, and a grudge against everything standing.

IGUI_ALifeUI_0139755b709ac2e8.baglam: Visitors · tutum: neutral · Hitchhikers, walkers and people with a bag and no destination. They turn up at a door once and move on.
